text: Let us recap. An ether is R O R dash, an isomer of an alcohol, simple or mixed. The smaller group is named as alkoxy. Ethers show metamerism. Williamson's synthesis is an S N two reaction, so the bulky group must be the alkoxide. With no O H, ethers cannot hydrogen bond to each other and boil low, yet dissolve in water. The oxygen is a Lewis base: cold acids give oxonium salts, hot H I breaks both bonds. Anisole gives phenol and iodomethane. Old ether forms explosive peroxides, and chlorine replaces the alpha hydrogens first.
